headline: Danantara Project 2027 Targets Additional GDP of Rp4,702 Trillion by 2034
summary: DDMF has designed 2027 investment projects that target an additional Rp4,702 trillion in GDP and 4.7 million new jobs by 2034, according to the report.
why: Danantara is Indonesia's sovereign investment vehicle, and its state-backed projects shape infrastructure spending and capital allocation in the country.
original_headline: Proyek Danantara 2027 Bidik Tambahan PDB Rp4.702 Triliun hingga 2034
